nodes.label: Persistence: minimize disk traffic standard
nodes.rationale: Mutate in memory, write at lifecycle boundaries, skip unchanged writes, batch, read once, prefer async saves.

nodes.label: Subagent model selection policy
nodes.rationale: Match capability to task: opus for reasoning-heavy, sonnet for moderate, haiku for mechanical lookups; fable unusable as subagent.

nodes.label: True 1:1 scale with double-precision universe coordinates
nodes.rationale: UE Large World Coordinates cover only about +-88 million km while Neptune is ~4.5 billion km out, so LWC alone is insufficient; rendering is camera-relative.
nodes.norm_label: true 1:1 scale with double-precision universe coordinates

nodes.label: Origin rebasing with anchor hysteresis
nodes.rationale: Switch anchor only when distance to new body under 25% of distance to current anchor so origin does not thrash at midpoint; interpretation of user wording, to confirm.

nodes.label: Analytic Keplerian orbits, no perturbations
nodes.rationale: Deterministic and O(1) per body at any time, so time-warp and jumps are trivial and velocity is exact for speed-matching.
